description: This file defines a Java interface, 'RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder', which extends a query command response builder for retrieving feature properties in a live command context. It includes nested interface 'ResponseFactory' for creating success and error responses related to retrieving feature property data.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses to retrieve feature property commands in a live query context.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertyLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Inner interface that defines methods for creating success and error response objects.

methods.name: retrieved
methods.description: Creates a success response containing the retrieved feature property value.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating lack of access or non-existence of the feature property.
